items.title: Make story_review numeric round field explicit
items.context: The handler response currently uses reviewRound: reviewData.reviews.length for PLAN review rounds, while signed finding/pass artifacts use reviewRound as story.currentReviewRound ISO string. Keep behavior compatible if needed, but add a clearly named numeric field such as planReviewRound/reviewRoundNumber and make the ambiguity visible in tests/docs.

items.title: Add regression coverage for reviewRound schema distinction
items.context: Tests should prove signed finding/pass reviewRound remains ISO string and story_review numeric round is exposed under an unambiguous name, so future contract drift catches this class of confusion.
